//: Self-contained on purpose: bundlers (vite/esbuild in the root CI vitest) load this file for every module they transform, so it must not extend a file that only exists after Claude Code (>= 2.1.287) has loaded the plugin. Claude Code writes its declarations to .claude-plugin/types/ (gitignored) when it LOADS the plugin (`claude plugin validate` does not); tsc -p . then reads them through typeRoots. A fresh clone or worktree has none and tsc stops at TS2688: scripts/typecheck.sh copies them from the main checkout, then runs tsc.
